lines.en: I step sideways through the shallows.
Six legs cross the wet mud.

lines.zh: 丛林的水塘边，我慢慢走。
lines.en: Along the jungle pond I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬起前足，探前面的路。
lines.en: I lift my forelegs to test the path.
Drops fall from the leaves onto my back.

lines.zh: 我绕着一丛蕨类爬过去。
lines.en: I climb around a clump of ferns.
Small insects move in the mud.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面走，影子很长。
lines.en: I walk on the water, my shadow long.

lines.zh: 密林太暗，我靠触角探路。
lines.en: Too dark; I feel the way with antennae.

lines.zh: 我和另一只隔着一片叶子。
lines.en: Another of my kind waits beyond a leaf.
My feet touch down on floating weed.
The pond bank is covered in my tracks.
I squeeze into a gap in the vines.

lines.zh: 湿热的空气糊住我的翅。
lines.en: The wet heat clings to my wings.

lines.zh: 我从一片浮萍跳到另一片。
lines.en: I hop from one duckweed patch to the next.

lines.zh: 水边有只蛙，我停下来看它。
lines.en: A frog sits by the water. I stop and watch it.
I hold my forelegs up and do not move.
Not even wind moves in this jungle.

lines.zh: 一片叶子慢慢落到水里。
lines.en: A leaf drifts down onto the water.
I am waiting for an insect to come.
I turn my head a little.
The pond shows my green shell.
Cicadas call without stopping.
I close my forelegs and open them.
Water beads on me; I ignore them.
These ferns hide me well.

lines.zh: 我听见枝头有东西在爬。
lines.en: I hear something crawling on a branch.
Staying still costs the least.
You snap a twig and I look up.
You stop at the pond and I stare.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里全是你的影子。
lines.en: My compound eyes are full of you.
Your feet are far too near my leaf.

lines.zh: 我把三角形的头对准你。
lines.en: I aim my triangular head at you.
You are looking for me; I know.
I raise my forelegs so you see.

lines.zh: 你身上带着汗和泥的气味。
lines.en: You smell of sweat and mud.
I retreat behind a leaf to watch.
You are neither insect nor bird.
Who stepped on me? My shell is cracked.
I cannot lift my forelegs.
I stumble toward the leaves.
That blow knocked me over.
It hurts enough to shake my wings.
I spit a little green fluid.
Enough; I am backing into the ferns.
A whole leg is missing now.
Muddy water covers the wound.
I stiffen all six legs like dead wood.
Is that the smell of an insect?
Give me that small bug in your hand.
I stretch my neck and sniff.
Is it still alive?
I creep slowly toward your hand.

lines.zh: 轻点捏，那只虫给我留着。
lines.en: Ease your grip; keep that bug alive.
Both spiked forelegs are up already.
You wiggle it; I move with it.
That is not enough to fill me.
A little further and I can reach.
You stepped on me; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我撞在你鞋上，壳都响了。
lines.en: I hit your shoe and my shell rings.
Do not crowd; the bank is narrow.
Your shove rolled me half over.
You are blocking me; make a path.

lines.zh: 我的足在你腿上抓了一下。
lines.en: My legs scrape once across your leg.
One push and I fall into the shallows.
The leaves shake where we collided.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，我举起足。
lines.en: We pass close; I raise my forelegs.
After the bump I back into the ferns.

lines.zh: 我们两只在叶下碰触角。
lines.en: Under a leaf we touch antennae.
Her forelegs are thinner than mine.
The reeds at the pond hide us both.

lines.zh: 我围着她半圈半圈地走。
lines.en: I walk half circles around her.
She lifts her forelegs in answer.

lines.zh: 这一片水塘只容我们俩。
lines.en: This pond has room for only us two.
Our wings rasp softly together.
She waits for me on the floating weed.
The wet season is the right time.
There will be a clutch of small mantises.
You have pinched me and lifted.

lines.zh: 我的前足在你指间乱抓。
lines.en: My forelegs claw between your fingers.
Put me down; I hate heights.
Away from the jungle I will dry out.
Your palm is too hot.
I twist to bite your finger.
My legs wrap around your sleeve.

lines.zh: 外面的光刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The light outside is too bright.

lines.zh: 你要把我带去哪个水塘？
lines.en: Which pond are you taking me to?

lines.zh: 我缩起来，装作一根枯枝。
lines.en: I fold my body into a dead twig.
An insect has landed on a leaf.

lines.zh: 我盯住了那片晃动的叶。
lines.en: I fix on that trembling leaf.
A moth flew over the pond.
I see its wings shaking.
It is less than a leg away.
Those footsteps are heavier than a bug.

lines.zh: 两只复眼一起对准了它。
lines.en: Both compound eyes fix on it.
The grass at the water moved.
It is prey; I am certain.
I turn my whole head toward it.
It has noticed me too.
It moved first; I wait.

lines.zh: 我把身子贴到叶面再挪。
lines.en: I flatten onto the leaf and shift.
One step, another, do not startle it.
My forelegs are raised as high as they go.
It stops; I stop too.
My reflection in the water gives me away.
I circle around to its flank.
The shaking is its wings, not mine.
Close enough; I wait for it to move.
My legs tighten on the leaf surface.

lines.zh: 它一偏头，我跟着挪半步。
lines.en: It turns; I shift half a step.
A leaf is blocking my view.

lines.zh: 我数着它的每一次振翅。
lines.en: I count every beat of its wings.
My forelegs close and it is caught.
My mandibles bite into its shell.
It fights the clamp; I hold tight.
One clamp and it stops moving.
I lift the prey to my mouth.
Its blood is on my forelegs.
I chew it away piece by piece.
It kicks at me; I do not care.
What I catch, I never release.
When I finish I clean my legs.
I hatch at the edge of the jungle pond.
Wet heat hits me at once.
The ferns stand far above me.
I raise my forelegs for the first time.
The pond is shallow and the mud soft.
One of my kind is not far off.
I climb the trunk of a tree.

lines.zh: 碎光从密叶的破口漏下。
lines.en: Broken light leaks through the canopy.
There are many insects here.
I hide under a leaf and begin to wait.
Flame catches my wings and I run wild.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下来，腿发麻。
lines.en: I fell from the tree; my legs are numb.

lines.zh: 我被按进水里，鳃没有用。
lines.en: Held under water, my gills are useless.
A blast throws me through the air.
An arrow pins through my thorax.
Strange light wraps me and I feel cold.
Three days without bugs and my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 雷光劈下，我的复眼全白。
lines.en: Lightning breaks; my eyes go white.
No leaves here, and no mud.
